items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 45:1
items.html: (To the question) For ZA has no Mochin of Chaya unless he ascends for Ibur to the GAR of AA — that is, Aba and Ima are in the place of the GAR of Atik, and their belly, which is YESHSUT, is in the place of the GAR of AA — when she receives the stature of his Mochin from AA in the aspect of neither upright nor bowed, as above, Part 14, Item 193 and Answer 79, see there. However, on weekdays, when the Mochin come from the bowing of the head of AA downward, to the place of the Aba and Ima of AB, this suffices only for the aspect of Jacob, who is the aspect of the Achoraim of Aba and Ima, and does not need to receive from the aspect of Atik, who is the Keter of Atzilut, for Aba and Ima have a hold only on AB, as said there in the Inner Light, see there. Therefore ZA needs to bow his head, with the Mochin he received from YESHSUT, down to the place of the standing of Jacob, namely from the chest and below, which then ascends to the place of the HGT, so that Jacob receives these Mochin of Neshama of ZA, which suffice for him for the Mochin of Chaya and for the birth; and he is the one who bestows them to the Nukva and couples with her face to face. See well in the above Inner Light. (Item 23).
